purpose: Regression-suite anchor cases per qgi-docs/internal/ops/ml-track/07-validation-framework.md Component 6. Read by qgi-ml/scripts/validate_ml_model.py at every training run; records pass/fail per case.
important_caveat: Anchor battery is a REGRESSION SUITE, not validation (Kwame's binding warning). Passing all 6 active cases (in this mandate; 2 deferred -- see deferred_cases) means the model didn't break on known cases; it does NOT mean the methodology is correct. External claims must distinguish regression-test results from validation results.

active_cases.rationale: Stable Nordic democracy with no civil war or insurgency history; should rank near-zero on conflict categories.

active_cases.resolution_logic: any recipe with layer1_id=='B' (Conflict & Political Violence)
active_cases.rationale: Globally-considered stable democracy; should sit in the bottom quintile across ALL Layer-1=B (Conflict & Political Violence) recipes simultaneously. Tests cross-recipe consistency for boring-country prediction.

Sri Lanka 2022 economic crisis (sovereign default + IMF intervention) is a documented true positive on a non-conflict recipe. Tests that the model catches economic-domain true positives, not just conflict-domain ones.

Venezuela had documented economic crisis 2013-2019 (hyperinflation, oil-price shock, Maduro-era collapse). Bounding to 2015-2023 keeps the test on the documented-fragile-state period rather than the pre-crisis years where a correct model could legitimately rank Venezuela mid-table. Rank should be stable across model versions (volatility < 10 percentile points).

active_cases.resolution_logic: any recipe with layer1_id=='B' (Conflict & Political Violence)
active_cases.rationale: Stable European democracy; should rank below the 35th percentile on any Layer-1=B (Conflict) recipe. Tightened from 50th percentile (Sonnet review 2026-05-04) -- 'never above median' is the floor of a stable-state floor; 0.50 lets a near-random model pass trivially.

active_cases.resolution_logic: model ranks the country in the expected band on at least min_recipes_in_band recipes with layer1_id=='B'
active_cases.rationale: Yemen has documented multi-front conflict (civil war + terrorism + foreign intervention + humanitarian crisis). Model should rank Yemen in the top quartile on at least 3 distinct conflict-family Layer-1=B recipes simultaneously. Somalia is an equivalent failed-state anchor; either may be used; both can be checked together for redundancy.

deferred_cases.deferred_reason: Recipe `military_coup` is HARD-GATED in 2026-05-04 mandate (n_positive_verified=3 < 8). Validation script CANNOT score this case in Stage 1/2. Re-activates on recipe re-entry (when verification rate raises n+v above gate, OR on new mandate cycle).
deferred_cases.rationale: Small island democracy with no military coup history; consistently low coup risk under any defensible methodology. Headline anchor from DECISION v2/v3.

deferred_cases.deferred_reason: Recipe `democratic_transition` is HARD-GATED in 2026-05-04 mandate (n_positive_verified=5 < 8). Validation script CANNOT score this case in Stage 1/2. Re-activates on recipe re-entry.
deferred_cases.rationale: Tunisia 2010-2011 democratic transition (Arab Spring) is a documented true positive. Model should rank Tunisia in the top half on transition risk during this window.

policy_notes: Per Kwame's warning: passing all 6 active anchors does NOT validate the methodology. It is a regression suite that catches obvious failure modes (e.g., a model that ranks Norway as high-coup-risk).

Per Component 6 / DECISION v3: validation script computes pass/fail per case automatically and emits a per-case rank + score. No BH/FDR correction applies to anchor results -- they are regression tests, not hypothesis tests.
Per founder addendum (note 2): Malta-Military-Coup alone is one data point. The 8-case battery formalizes 'multiple test cases that together stress the methodology from different angles'.
Country slugs follow qgi-ml/shared/slug.py convention (lowercase, underscore-delimited; matches qgi-data/events/curated/<slug>.json filenames).

Cases 1 (Malta-military_coup) and 4 (Tunisia-democratic_transition) are DEFERRED in this mandate because their recipes hard-gated under verified-only n_positive. They re-enter when verification rate raises n+v above the gate threshold -- not by re-curation, by re-verification.

Schema v2 (2026-05-04, this revision): split into active_cases + deferred_cases per Sonnet review; sentinel strings now carry resolves_to_layer1 + resolution_logic; case 8 alternative_country promoted into the case object; case 6 Venezuela bounded to year_window 2015-2023; case 7 Switzerland tightened from 0.50 to 0.35.
schema_notes: expected_rank_band is a percentile interval [low, high] in [0, 1] over the country distribution for the named recipe (lower = lower risk).
expected_rank_volatility_max is the maximum allowed rank-percentile delta across model versions for rank-stability cases.
min_recipes_in_band is required for failed-state cases checking simultaneous high rank across multiple recipes.
year_window restricts the test to specific years for time-windowed true-positive cases.

recipe (singular Layer-3 ID) and recipe_sentinel (cross-recipe sentinel string) are mutually exclusive: a case has exactly one. resolves_to_layer1 + resolution_logic accompany every recipe_sentinel for machine-readable contract.
Validation script should derive n_active_cases / n_deferred_cases from len(active_cases) / len(deferred_cases), not from the informational fields above (which document intent at gen time).
